response.rationale: Although the step guardrail clears, the shrunk realised dROAS (1.23) sits ~23% below the 1.6 goal, so pushing bids higher on an under-goal cell risks worsening ROAS further. Tier B evidence with 18 orders makes the shrunk estimate moderately reliable, so the shortfall is likely real but not certain. Dampen the small +5% raise to roughly 60% of its size (≈ +INR 12) — enough to preserve incremental-volume probing, not enough to chase a losing ROAS position.
